title: V1.1.2K local O:NR card release adds exactly 20 confirmed cards
preconditions: The private local O:NR v1 overlay exists under data/local.
The previous V1.0.5K and V1.0.6K releases remain active.
Non-release O:NR cards remain not deck_legal in the runtime catalog.
steps: Apply the runtime release gate and promote exactly the 20 V1.1.2K cards to implemented, playable and deck_legal.
Validate V1.1.2K Runner and Corp smoke decks through the deck validator.
Install the six Runner breakers and use existing code-gate and sentry break rules.
Play Netwatch Credit Voucher and Night Shift through existing operation resolvers.
Rez the V1.1.2K ICE, verify unrezzed titles remain hidden until rez, and replay the resulting StateHash path.
expected: V1.1.2K adds exactly 20 further local O:NR cards.
Runtime catalog contains 52 local O:NR release cards total, including V1.0.5K and V1.0.6K.
Deck validation and private match setup accept the new cards.
Visibility, replay, StateHash and AI input contracts remain covered.
Private local text and image artifacts remain ignored and are not versioned.
